observation.visible_scene: A forested stream bed framed by dense green trees and shrubs, with pale, smooth rock banks on both sides. In the mid-left a small cascade tumbles over dark stones into white, frothy rapids, which empty into a calmer, dark green pool occupying the foreground. A leafy branch hangs over the water in the center-right. A static watermark reading "Healing Nature & Meditation" sits in the bottom-left corner. The overall lighting is bright and dappled, with a washed-out sky glow through the canopy at top center.
visible_changes: The white turbulent water of the cascade continuously churns and reshapes: foam patches break, merge, and re-form over the rocks from frame to frame, indicating ongoing downstream flow rather than a start or stop.

The foreground pool shows moving surface ripples and shifting bright light reflections that wander across the water, consistent with flowing water and shimmering reflections rather than discrete objects.
The camera is fixed: the trees, rock banks, hanging branch, and watermark remain in identical positions throughout the excerpt, so all visible motion is in the water, not the viewpoint.
The rocks, tree trunks, and dense foliage remain static; the hanging leafy branch shows no clear displacement.
The scene is already in motion at the first frame and continues in motion at the last, with no onset, contact, or completion visible.
outside_clip_unknowns: What lies upstream and downstream beyond the cropped frame, and the source or destination of the flow.
Whether any wind is present (no clear leaf motion is visible to confirm or deny it).
Audio characteristics such as water sound, which cannot be inferred from frames.
uncertain_details: Whether the leaves on the overhanging branch sway even slightly is not resolvable from the frames.
The exact speed and volume of the flow cannot be measured, only that it is steady and continuous.
Any sub-pixel camera jitter is too small to confirm against the static background.
